text: welcome to the line test facility.
Press 1, to hear you telephone number. Press 2, for a ring back test. Press 3, for a Quiet line test. Press 4, for an echo test. Or Press 5, for a D.T.M.F test
The echo test will start after the beep. Anything you say will be repeated back to you.
The D.T.M.F test will start after the beep. Any digits entered will be repeated back to you.
The quiet line test will start after the beep.
You have requested a ring back test. A ring back has been scheduled.
